summary: Niue’s conservation pledges focus on its ocean: it commits to effectively managing 100% of its EEZ by 2030, including a 127,000 km² no-take marine protected area covering 40% of the EEZ, and sets a conditional goal to protect all ocean components with carbon-sequestration potential by 2030. Its forest commitments combine conservation and restoration: the 2013 plan records about 19,000 ha of native forest, roughly 88% of the 215 km² currently mapped as forest, while the pledge maintains mature dense forest equal to 21% of land and regenerates medium-dense forest equal to 51%. These represent approximately 55 km² and 134 km², respectively, against 263 km² of total land. No agriculture-specific numerical commitment is stated.
